resources.name: WS2/BlueP heterostructure lattice constants and stacking

access.notes: Lattice constants: WS2 a=3.185 Å, BlueP a=3.278 Å. Heterostructure built using a 3x3 supercell with Model III stacking (P atoms on top of W and S sites). These parameters are explicitly given in the paper and require no external file download.
